reason: Checked against the source. restore_game_zp is entered only by render's JMP (no 'restore_game_zp +' entries); zp_save (&BC00) is read only by render_zp.6502. Between JSR save_game_zp and JMP restore_game_zp no code stores to &02 &03 &7E &7F &80 &82 &83 &84 &8E &8F &94 &95 &9B under any of their zp.6502 names (count, mover_to_update, rank/score_offset/trigger_offset, new_movers_offset, helicopter_to_update/name_address, player_*, bottom_palette_value, lives, drawing): a grep of every src file except game/bank* finds only render_zp's own restores and logic-side writes (front_gameplay, shield, shield_hi), never called from render. The game.6502 routines render-phase code reaches (check_if_mover_is_on_screen, calculate_screen_addresses_for_mover_on_edge + add/subtract_delta, move_to_next_column, compiled_call) write &79 &B6 &B7 &CD &D0 &D1 and tables only. The only zero-page indexed store in render-phase files is need,X (&1F + <&22). irq1_handler writes field_count, game_over_cooldown, irq_accumulator, hardware; sfx_tick writes only absolute variables (&A5xx, &2A42); the MOS leaves &00-&9F alone. &00/&01: view_to_buffer X=2 copies them after save, buf_ss_*+2 is written nowhere else, and the unconditional buffer_to_view X=2 at .scrolled is the last store to them (put_on, compiled kinds and sky code do not store them). render_finish reaches the same body. Not protected, not generated, no data moved; nothing pinned between it and the &9000 SKIP (only labels move). Cost: 15 pairs of LDA abs (3 bytes, 4 cycles) + STA zp (2, 3) = 75 bytes, 105 cycles, as claimed; the code it moves down (sky_off take_off, shield) may cross pages differently, which the claim admits it does not count and the gate measures.
